paperTitle: OA-WAM: Object-Addressable World Action Model for Robust Robot Manipulation
organization: Tsinghua University / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Nanyang Technological University

benchmarks.label: LIBERO
benchmarks.detail: Suites: libero spatial 98.9 · libero object 99.0 · libero goal 97.4 · libero long 95.9 | Table 1 | Notes: Standard four-suite LIBERO evaluation; all numbers are success rates averaged over three seeds.

benchmarks.label: SimplerEnv
benchmarks.detail: Suites: SimplerEnv WidowX Bridge visual matching 79.3 | Tasks: put spoon on towel 83.0 · put carrot on plate 71.1 · stack cube 65.0 · put eggplant in basket 98.2 | Table 1 and Appendix H | Notes: Official SimplerEnv visual-matching protocol on the WidowX Bridge suite; each task uses 25 episodes per cell repeated over three seeds.

benchmarks.label: LIBERO-Plus
benchmarks.detail: Suites: camera 80.5 · robot init 89.6 · layout 82.8 · light 96.5 · background 95.9 · language 85.3 · sensor noise 75.6 | Table 2 | Notes: Zero-shot LIBERO-Plus robustness benchmark after training only on standard LIBERO demonstrations; Geo Avg over camera, robot init, and layout is 84.3.
